title: Chicken Nest-Box Visit vs Egg Count Gap
dataSources: Hive metrics (`flowhive:reading`), egg counter events (`eggcounter:event`), goat RFID visits (`goattag:scan`), goat watering and feed logs (`goatcare:event`), and compost readings (`compost:reading`).
app: Smallholding and backyard telemetry from Flow Hive scales, chicken coop counters, RFID goat tags, compost thermometers, and camera-driven chore logs sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eggcounter:event
| stats sum(nest_visits) as nest_visits sum(eggs_counted) as eggs_counted by coop_id
| eval visit_to_egg_gap=nest_visits-eggs_counted
| sort - visit_to_egg_gap
description: Examines nest-box visits versus egg counts.
value: A widening visit-to-egg gap often signals false triggers, hidden laying spots, or counter tuning issues.
implementation: Send nest-box visits versus egg counts events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of nest-box visits versus egg counts, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It totals what is happening with nest-box visits versus egg counts, so odd changes stand out quickly.
